tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen. Cards and panels sit on it as `surface`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, nav bar and buttons. Body text on it is `ink` or `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Progress tracks, translation blocks, pressed and hover fills. `ink` and `ink-muted` both read on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body text, headings, 3px/2px borders and hard shadows. Reads on `paper`, `surface`, `surface-sunken` and every `*-soft` tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (hints, meta lines, captions) on `paper`, `surface` and `surface-sunken`. Solid, never alpha: 4.5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and empty heat-map cells only. Never carries meaning; use `ink` for any boundary that does.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `ink` fill: the active nav tab, the current question number, selected segment.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand orange as a FILL: primary button, done cells, progress fill, heat-map peak. Always outlined by `ink`; text on it is `on-accent`. Do not use as a text colour or as the only boundary (2.9:1 on `paper`).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent` fills (6.3:1). Replaces the source's white, which was 3.3:1.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Orange used as TEXT or a line on `paper`, `surface` and `accent-soft`: streak numbers, today's week label, links in body copy.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for an accent-flavoured callout or a done-today card. `ink` text reads on it.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Correct answers and mastered progress as text, icon or border on `paper`, `surface` and `ok-soft`. A blue-teal, not green, so it survives red-green colour blindness beside `bad`. Always paired with a check icon and the word.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a correct answer and the correct feedback panel. `ink` text reads on it.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Wrong answers, errors, low-time and destructive actions as text, icon or border on `paper`, `surface` and `bad-soft`. Always paired with a cross icon and the word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a wrong answer, error field and error panel. `ink` text reads on it.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Yellow as a FILL for guides, warnings and the 'Guide' tag. Text on it is `on-warn`.

tokens.name: on-warn
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `warn` fills (14:1).

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Warning as TEXT on `paper`, `surface` and `warn-soft`: the light-theme value is a dark amber, the dark-theme value is the brand yellow.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a warning notice. `ink` text reads on it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: solid 3px outline, 3px offset, on every interactive element. 6.9:1 on `paper` (light), 7.9:1 on `paper` (dark).

tokens.name: heat-0
tokens.usage: Heat-map level 0: no questions that day. Pair every cell with a text alternative.

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Heat-map level 1: 1-5 questions.

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Heat-map level 2: 6-10 questions.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Heat-map level 3: 11-19 questions.

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Heat-map level 4: daily goal met (20+).

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Big numerals and hero words (streak, pass rate, result screen). Set uppercase.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Screen titles on tablet and desktop, stat values. Set uppercase.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles on phones. Set uppercase, one line.

styles.name: question
styles.usage: The exam statement being judged Vero or Falso. Never uppercase, never smaller than this.
styles.sample: Una zona a traffico limitato è un'area nella quale è consentito solo il transito di ciclomotori e biciclette.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and panel titles. Sentence case.

styles.name: body-l
styles.usage: Lesson text in the Theory reader and explanations.
styles.sample: Read the Italian first, translate only when stuck.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: You have not answered a question yet.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside running text and list leads.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Meta lines, hints, helper text. Colour `ink-muted`.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, field labels, panel titles. Set uppercase.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Tags, nav tab labels, week-day letters. The smallest text in the system. Set uppercase.

styles.name: button-lg
styles.usage: Answer buttons and the primary action in a flow. Set uppercase.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: Keyboard hints (V, F, T). Desktop only.

spacing.note: 4px base. Compose screens from these steps only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tag inner padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tightly related controls; week-strip cells.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between the two answer buttons; input inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones, screen side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Grid gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding, screen gutter from tablet up.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Above a screen title on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large section breaks; the minimum tap target.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Bottom clearance above the tab bar.

radius.note: Square by design. Corners are the exception.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, panels, inputs, bars: everything by default.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Keyboard hints only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Streak dots and the goal ring's end cap; never on buttons.

shadow.note: Hard offset, zero blur, in the ink colour. Pressing removes it.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags-as-buttons, answer buttons, cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Panels, hovered cards, the feedback panel and dialogs.

border.note: Two weights only; both in `ink` unless a state colour is stated.

tokens.name: border-2
tokens.usage: Tags, tracks, week cells, nav dividers, kbd.

tokens.name: border-3
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, buttons, inputs, answer buttons.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of any touch target.

tokens.name: nav-h
tokens.usage: Height of the bottom tab bar before the safe-area inset.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the reading column on tablet and desktop.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Tab bar and masthead.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs and their scrim.
